VISA COPY MANDATORY FOR SUBMISSION. 
   Job Description 
   • 8+ years of relevant industry experience in a fast paced dynamic environment 
 • Excellent working knowledge HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery
 • Diverse experience with other JavaScript frameworks like Angular, Ember, D3, Highcharts
 • Basic administration skills across web servers, application servers (Apache, Tomcat)
 • Python, Django, Jinja templating experience a plus
 • Graphic and usability design skills a plus
 • Mobile application development experience a plus
 • Practical experience designing and developing analytical application front ends, encompassing data table displays and manipulation, drill down, trending graphs, business intelligence like interactions


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ Months
